Higgsfield

Website Instagram

Who they are

Higgsfield is an AI-native creative platform — 'create images, videos and voice content from text prompts or references.' It's known for cinematic AI video with real camera moves and ready-made VFX presets (Cinema Studio, Genjutsu motion transfer, Seedance) plus image generation — the go-to for viral AI video among creators (1.69M on Instagram).

What they want

  • Deliverable: 60 original short-form videos / month (2 a day) posted on your Instagram, + reposts to TikTok / YouTube / Facebook daily. Reply to comments and engage like a creator, not a brand account.
  • Pay: $1,000/mo base for the 60 IG videos + $150 for the reposts (TT/YT/FB). Bonuses: $500 per video over 1M views, $250 over 500k, $100 over 100k.
  • Great fit: understand filming, hooks & editing; done UGC before; heavy social-media user who knows what performs; genuinely into AI / editing / tech content.
  • Angle to model: viral AI-video / VFX content — jaw-drop AI transformations, 'made with AI', cinematic AI clips, VFX-preset reveals, AI film & music videos. Study the competitors + keyword sections below for the formats that actually hit.
